title: Al-Masad 111:3-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ikhlas, Al-Masad and joining letters
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Masad 111:3-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ (٣) وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ (٤) فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Masad 111:3-5 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 111:3-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Say all of Al-Masad to a friend.

questions.a: A) A rope of palm fibre. مَسَد is palm-fibre rope (111:5).

questions.q: Think again: 111:5 talks about a rope of palm fibre. Have you ever seen a rope made from plants?
questions.a: Palm fibre is twisted into rough rope (masad); the surah takes its name from it.
